chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:

Whoever is pleased to meet Allah in a state of purity and purification, then let him meet Him with a spouse. And whoever abandons marriage out of fear of poverty has thought poorly of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.أَسَاءَ اَلظَّنَّ: held an evil opinion or thought poorly
key_terms.بِزَوْجَةٍ: with a spouse, i.e. in the state of being married

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about avoiding marriage because of fear of poverty?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages marriage and presents it as a means of moral and spiritual purity. It also condemns avoiding marriage out of fear of poverty, describing such fear as سوء ظنّ toward Allah, Who provides for His servants.
